description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Paul thanks God for the growing faith and love of the Thessalonians as they endure persecution. God will judge rightly when the Lord Jesus appears, giving rest to those who suffer and punishment to those who make them suffer.
1.sw: Paulo anamshukuru Mungu kwa imani na upendo unaokua wa Wathesalonike wanapovumilia mateso. Mungu atahukumu kwa haki Bwana Yesu atakapotokea, akiwapa raha wale wanaoteseka na adhabu wale wanaowatesa.
1.am: ጳውሎስ የተሰሎንቄ ሰዎች ስደትን በትዕግሥት ሲቋቋሙ ስለሚያድገው እምነታቸውና ፍቅራቸው እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል። ጌታ ኢየሱስ በሚገለጥበት ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር በትክክል ይፈርዳል፤ መከራ ለሚቀበሉት ዕረፍትን፣ መከራ ለሚያደርሱባቸውም ቅጣትን ይሰጣል።

2.en: Paul tells the believers not to be alarmed by claims that the day of the Lord has already come: the rebellion and the man of lawlessness must come first, and the Lord Jesus will destroy him. He thanks God that they were chosen to be saved and urges them to hold firmly to what they were taught.
2.sw: Paulo anawaambia waamini wasitishwe na madai kwamba siku ya Bwana imekwisha kufika: ukengeufu na yule mtu wa uasi lazima vije kwanza, naye Bwana Yesu atamwangamiza. Anamshukuru Mungu kwamba walichaguliwa kuokolewa na kuwahimiza washike kwa uthabiti yale waliyofundishwa.
2.am: ጳውሎስ አማኞች የጌታ ቀን ደርሷል በሚሉ ወሬዎች እንዳይደናገጡ ይነግራቸዋል፤ ክህደቱና የሕገ ወጥነት ሰው አስቀድመው መምጣት አለባቸው፤ ጌታ ኢየሱስም ያጠፋዋል። እንዲድኑ ስለ ተመረጡ እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል፤ የተማሩትንም አጥብቀው እንዲይዙ ያሳስባቸዋል።

3.en: Paul asks for prayer and expresses confidence that the Lord will strengthen them. He commands them to keep away from believers who refuse to work, to earn their own living, and not to tire of doing good, and he signs the greeting in his own hand.
3.sw: Paulo anaomba waombewe na kuonyesha imani kwamba Bwana atawaimarisha. Anawaamuru wajitenge na waamini wanaokataa kufanya kazi, wajipatie riziki yao wenyewe, na wasichoke kutenda mema, naye anatia sahihi salamu kwa mkono wake mwenyewe.
3.am: ጳውሎስ እንዲጸልዩለት ይለምናል፤ ጌታ እንደሚያጸናቸውም ያለውን እምነት ይገልጻል። ለመሥራት እምቢ ከሚሉ አማኞች እንዲርቁ፣ የራሳቸውን መተዳደሪያ እንዲያገኙና መልካም ከማድረግ እንዳይታክቱ ያዝዛቸዋል፤ ሰላምታውንም በገዛ እጁ ይፈርማል።
